description: A challenge that names a RulesetVersion the server's current ruleset catalog can no longer play (below its MinimumCompatibleVersion) is rejected at creation, before any attempt is issued.
notes: Mirrors Unity's VersusSeriesValidator.ValidatePlayable + CompetitiveRuleset.CanPlayVersion (checked at attempt-issue time client-side). The remote contract must check this at CreateChallenge time instead: the client must never be authoritative for ruleset-version selection (issue #8 section 8). The Backend has no RulesetId/RulesetVersion/MinimumCompatibleVersion concept at all today, so there is nothing to reject against - this is required net-new work for #9 (frozen rules must carry ruleset id/version) and #10 (creation-time resolution/rejection).
